company.name: Velos BioImaging
company.tagline: Label-free quantitative phase imaging for live-cell research
company.description: Velos BioImaging builds Velos QPI, a compact 630 nm ptychographic imaging system, and SPARK, its physics-based, sparse-scanning and AI-assisted reconstruction software, for label-free live-cell monitoring, cell biology and drug discovery.

home.headline: See living cells quantitatively. No labels, fewer scans.
home.subheadline: A compact benchtop quantitative phase imaging platform that recovers amplitude and phase of transparent specimens from fewer measurements, with physics-based reconstruction you can trust and AI acceleration when you need speed.

features.title: Label-free live-cell imaging
features.body: Quantitative phase converts optical path delay into measurable images of morphology, dry-mass proxies and growth, without dyes or fluorescent labels.

features.title: Sparse-scanning reconstruction
features.body: Our core technology recovers high-quality phase from fewer scan positions, cutting acquisition time and motion sensitivity for time-lapse experiments.

features.title: Physics first, AI where it helps
features.body: SPARK keeps the physics-based engine as the quantitative reference and uses learned models for initialisation, refinement and fast previews, always checked against the measurement.

features.title: Built for biology labs
features.body: A compact enclosure, guided acquisition protocols and exportable metrics let labs without optics expertise run longitudinal assays.

how_it_works.title: Place the sample
how_it_works.body: Culture dish or slide on the XY stage; pick a predefined acquisition protocol.

how_it_works.title: Acquire
how_it_works.body: A coherent 630 nm probe scans overlapping positions while the CMOS camera records diffraction frames with full metadata.

how_it_works.title: Reconstruct in SPARK
how_it_works.body: Choose physics-based, sparse-scanning, AI-assisted or hybrid reconstruction; quality indicators are reported with every result.

how_it_works.title: Measure
how_it_works.body: Segment and track cells; export area, phase-derived biomass, migration and treatment-response metrics.

applications.title: Cell biology
applications.body: Morphology and phenotyping, growth and proliferation, migration and wound healing, cell-cycle events, cell–material interactions.

applications.title: Drug discovery & toxicology
applications.body: Dose–response profiling, time-of-response analysis, cytotoxic vs cytostatic separation, combination studies, spheroid response tracking.

applications.title: Microbiology & education
applications.body: Yeast and microbial growth monitoring, and an affordable entry point for teaching labs and core facilities.

product.headline: Velos QPI and SPARK
product.intro: Velos QPI combines compact 630 nm imaging hardware with synchronised scanning and camera acquisition. SPARK turns the recorded diffraction frames into quantitative amplitude and phase images through a controlled set of reconstruction engines that share one data model, calibration and quality-control workflow.

hardware.detail: 630 nm diode laser with spatial filtering or fibre delivery; monitored power and parasitic-reflection control.
Aperture / relay optics define the illumination; the probe is characterised and jointly recovered in reconstruction.
XY stage with culture-dish compatibility; temperature / CO₂ enclosure planned for long time-lapse.
Scientific or industrial CMOS camera selected for pixel size, dynamic range and sensitivity.
Hardware-triggered stage–camera synchronisation with per-frame coordinates and QC metadata.
Light-tight benchtop housing with kinematic mounts and alignment references.

modes.name: Physics-based
modes.body: Iterative ptychographic phase retrieval with probe recovery, position refinement and convergence monitoring. The quantitative reference and the source of training labels.

modes.name: Sparse-scanning
modes.body: Graph-based coupling between scan positions and adaptive priors keep phase quality with fewer measurements. A reconstruction is rejected if it changes quantitative cell features.

modes.name: AI-assisted
modes.body: Learned initialisation, refinement and artifact detection for near-real-time previews; held-out validation and physics-consistency checks are built in.

modes.name: Hybrid
modes.body: AI initialisation followed by a physics-consistency step for difficult or low-signal datasets.

software_platform.title: Upload & manage data
software_platform.body: Secure upload of microscopy datasets with automatic geometry checks and metadata capture.

software_platform.title: Asynchronous reconstruction jobs
software_platform.body: Submit jobs through the web or API; track status and progress; retrieve amplitude/phase results and metrics when ready.

software_platform.title: Quality indicators
software_platform.body: Data-consistency error, coverage maps and convergence curves accompany every reconstruction.

software_platform.title: Open outputs
software_platform.body: Images, phase maps, CSV metrics and reproducible experiment reports for your analysis pipeline.

product.validation_note: Validation progresses from calibration targets (USAF, phase steps, beads) to fixed cells, live 2D cultures and drug-response assays before any spheroid or organoid claims.
